change.description: New method added to RuleStore interface. All implementations must add ListByDatasource to filter alert rules by datasource UID.

breaking_patterns.why_breaks: Concrete implementation does not implement the new method ListByDatasource.
Local interface definition lacks the new method and will be incompatible with implementations that expect the full interface.
Test fake/mock does not implement the new method, causing test compilation failures.

terms.reason: The changed interface itself in all its definitions.
Primary implementation of RuleStore that must add the new method.
Similar listing method - files implementing this likely need the new method too.
Implementations of this interface method indicate RuleStore implementors.
Test doubles/fakes that implement RuleStore must add the new method.
Existing datasource filtering field - related to new ListByDatasource functionality.
Datasource UID field in AlertQuery/AlertRule models.
